# Video Cut

> Fast, lightweight, and lossless video editor built natively for Linux with GTK4 and Libadwaita.

Video Cut is a free and open-source desktop video editor designed specifically for modern Linux desktops (GNOME / Libadwaita). It enables users to cut, trim, split, merge, crop, rotate, and combine video clips and still images without painful render times or quality loss.

- **Website**: https://thor27.github.io/video-cut/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/thor27/video-cut
- **Releases**: https://github.com/thor27/video-cut/releases
- **License**: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
- **Primary Platform**: Linux (x86_64)

## Key Capabilities

1. **Lossless Cutting & Keyframe Splitting**:
   - Split video segments with keyframe boundary snapping.
   - Reorder, duplicate, copy/paste, or delete clips on a visual multi-segment timeline.
   - Stream copy export mode to preserve original video/audio quality without re-encoding.

2. **Visual Crop & Rotate**:
   - Interactive crop selection rectangle with real-time preview.
   - Quick aspect ratio presets: 16:9 (Widescreen), 9:16 (TikTok / YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels), 1:1 (Square), 4:3, 21:9.
   - 90°, 180°, 270° clockwise and counter-clockwise rotation.
   - Horizontal and vertical flipping (mirroring).

3. **Mixed Media & Photo Import**:
   - Import still photos and images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) directly into video timelines.
   - Configure per-image display duration.
   - Attach soundtrack audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, Ogg) with configurable start offset and duration slicing.

4. **Advanced Export & Codecs**:
   - Supports popular containers: MP4 (.mp4), Matroska (.mkv), WebM (.webm).
   - Hardware-accelerated and software video codecs: H.264 / AVC, H.265 / HEVC, VP9, AV1.
   - Audio codecs: AAC, MP3, Opus, FLAC, Vorbis.
   - Configurable CRF quality, bitrates, resolutions, and frame rates.

5. **Native GNOME Desktop Integration**:
   - Native GTK4 and Libadwaita design language.
   - Dynamic system dark and light theme following.
   - Keyboard navigation and drag-and-drop support.
   - 100% offline, private, and local execution with zero cloud telemetry.

## Packaging & Installation

- **AppImage**: Download portable VideoCut-0.3.0-x86_64.AppImage directly from GitHub Releases.
- **Snap**: Install from the Canonical Snap Store: `sudo snap install video-cut`
- **Flatpak**: Available as a standalone .flatpak bundle from GitHub Releases.
- **Source Code**: Clone `https://github.com/thor27/video-cut.git` and run with Python 3.11+ and PyGObject.
